mentions.name: Note-Taking Masquerade OS
mentions.description: An operating system disguised as simple note-taking software, built to end fragmented AI tools and apps owning user data. It eliminates context switching for the user and, as a byproduct, solves context switching for AI agents; previously used internally across three companies and now being productized.
mentions.problem: Disparate AI tools and apps own user data, and constant context switching between them hurts productivity.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Software: An OS that masquerades as simple note taking software.

Goal is to put an end to all the disparate AI bullshit and apps owning our data.

I solved context switching for myself ages ago and now I'm just trying to productize it outside my 3 companies internal usage.

It also solves context switching for AI agents as a byproduct.
